profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer | Distributed Systems & Real-Time Data Pipelines | Kafka • Go • Python • C++
profile.summary:
• 15+ years building high-performance distributed systems and real-time data platforms, scaling infrastructures to trillions of records daily and 20M+ messages/sec. 
• Skilled in Go, C++, Python, Kafka, MongoDB, and AWS, with expertise in backend engineering, large-scale data pipelines, and system optimization. 
• Passionate about turning massive data flows into actionable insights, from cloud security to climate technology.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Architecting the backend platform and agentic systems behind real-time carbon-capture telemetry and carbon-credit certification.
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · ClickHouse · Grafana · Go (Programming Language) · Python (Programming Language) · Docker · Kubernetes · Claude Skills · Amazon Kinesis · EMQX · NATS Jetstream · OPC Unified Architecture (OPC UA) · SCADA

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Redesigned a distributed analytics pipeline in Go, reducing data latency by 66% and cutting resource usage by 80%, significantly boosting system throughput and operational efficiency.
• Re-architected backend data pipeline to support real-time scalability, improving performance and reducing infrastructure overhead.
positions.insights: Skills: Apache Kafka · Go (Programming Language) · EMC Storage Products · Network-Attached Storage (NAS) · Collaborative Leadership · Cross-team Collaboration

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Engineered high-throughput Kafka consumers in Go processing 20M+ messages/sec, slashing end-to-end message latency from 15 minutes to 5 seconds.
• Led development of a distributed log processing system (C++/Python) handling 50+ trillion records/month, generating $2.5M/year in revenue and accelerating analytics by 10x.
• Architected a horizontally scalable storage system in Python, improving performance by 50% and saving $1.8M/year in infrastructure costs.
• Built a multi-dimensional time-series database in C++ that reduced query times from 2 minutes to 150ms, directly improving billing accuracy and cross-team adoption.
• Designed and implemented a secure log delivery service in Python, transmitting 100B+ records/day to enterprise clients.
• Deployed and managed MongoDB clusters handling trillions of records; built custom observability dashboards for real-time monitoring.
• Automated infrastructure provisioning with SaltStack, reducing deployment cycles and operational workload by 50%.
positions.insights: Skills: Technical Leadership · Software Design · Software Development · Software Infrastructure · Optimizing Performance · C++ · Go (Programming Language) · Python (Programming Language) · PHP · Protocol Buffers · MongoDB · ClickHouse · Elasticsearch · Grafana · Nginx · SaltStack · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Microsoft Azure · Apache Kafka · Cortex

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed a global message-publishing pipeline in Python handling 3PB+ of data/day, ensuring data security and high reliability.
• Led a full overhaul of the billing pipeline in C++, reducing report generation time from 4 hours to 15 minutes for 200K+ customers.
• Built a real-time CDN performance monitoring system using ZeroC Ice, providing operational insights for 100+ enterprise clients.
• Deployed the company's first high-availability Hadoop cluster, significantly enhancing data reporting capabilities.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Infrastructure · Software Design · Software Development · C++ · Python (Programming Language) · CGI/Perl · Hadoop · Content Distribution Networks

positions.title: Research And Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
• Conducted research leading to 10+ peer-reviewed publications in software engineering and distributed systems.
• Led the development of a P2P video storage and streaming system, optimizing resiliency and cost-effectiveness.
• Advised 300+ students in various EECS courses, providing mentorship for academic success.
